html:
Alaungpaya was a village chief from Shwebo who founded the Konbaung dynasty in 1752 and reunited Burma within eight years. It was the last dynasty to rule Burma.

When the Mon of Hanthawaddy took the Burman capital of Ava, he raised an army and drove them back, taking Pegu in 1757. In 1755 he renamed the town of Dagon as Yangon, meaning end of strife; it later grew into Rangoon, the capital.

He died in 1760 while invading Siam. His sons carried on the war and destroyed Ayutthaya in 1767. His dynasty fought the British in the Anglo-Burmese wars.
